scope: Supplementary source quality and identifier overlap only. No cleaning, model fitting, outcome inspection or activation.

steam_revenue_2024.interpretation: Gamalytic-derived estimated gross revenue; top-1500 selection, not a representative Steam cohort. Author describes releases from 2024-01-01 to 2024-09-09; check actual dates below. Not profit or verified developer receipts.
interpretation_flags: Zero price with positive revenue requires source-method verification; do not impute revenue as price times copies or treat these as errors automatically.
publisherClass is a provider label, not a verified measure of independent ownership or studio size.
September 2024 outcomes joined to March 2025 metadata support descriptive comparisons only; later metadata is not evidence of launch-time features.
Review score zero is preserved; its missing/unrated semantics need verification before score analysis.

mobile_highest_grossing.interpretation: Cumulative high-grossing mobile-game revenue compilation; not Android-only. Per-title revenue cutoff, platform coverage and revenue components are not supplied in the CSV. Release date is not a revenue observation date.

name_match_review.method: Unicode NFKC + casefold + whitespace; punctuation preserved, no fuzzy or combined-title matching.

name_match_review.status: Candidates only. Identity, publisher, platform and observation-period verification required; no automatic join.

steam_launch_panel_2026.interpretation: First-week gross revenue proxy in USD cents, derived from owners/reviews, price and assumed first-week shares. Not observed first-week sales; selected paid-game sample. Review/price predictors can reproduce the target construction.

log_check.note: Dataset card says log10; compare actual values before using this field.
